presets.name: Soft neo-brutalism
presets.what: Chunky black outlines and solid offset shadows on rounded pills over cream paper, with hand-drawn doodle icons.
presets.not: Not skeuomorphism: nothing imitates a real material; the depth is a flat block shadow.

presets.name: Hard neo-brutalism
presets.what: Square-cornered cards with thick black borders and big black offset shadows on a saturated yellow field, hot-pink and cyan accents.
presets.not: Not soft neo-brutalism: corners are square, colours are saturated, and nothing is hand-drawn.

presets.name: Raw web brutalism
presets.what: Unstyled-looking pages: Times-style serif, default blue links, grey system boxes, thin black borders, zero decoration or rounding.
presets.not: Not neo-brutalism: no playful colour or shadows; it looks unfinished on purpose, like 1996 HTML.

presets.name: Hard-sell retail
presets.what: Fire-engine red and sale yellow, huge condensed prices and percentages, starburst stickers and hard shadows like a weekend sale flyer.
presets.not: Not pop art: nothing is ironic or gallery-like; it is pure promotional urgency built around the number.

presets.name: Constructivism
presets.what: Red, black and aged cream; heavy condensed capitals, solid red slabs, thick rules and diagonal tension like a 1920s propaganda poster.
presets.not: Not Bauhaus: constructivism is red-and-black, diagonal and shouting; Bauhaus is primary colours, balanced geometry.

presets.name: Bauhaus
presets.what: Circles, squares and bars in red, yellow and blue on warm off-white, geometric lowercase type, black joins, everything balanced and flat.
presets.not: Not Memphis: Bauhaus is disciplined and primary-coloured; Memphis is chaotic, pastel and patterned.

presets.name: Pop art
presets.what: Ben-Day halftone dots, primary yellow, red and blue panels, heavy black outlines and punchy block lettering straight off a 1960s canvas.
presets.not: Not comic-book style: pop art is gallery-framed and ironic, flat colour plus dots, no story panels or characters.

presets.name: Acid graphics
presets.what: Black void, chrome and toxic lime, extended wide type, crosshairs and tiny technical labels, glitchy and rave-flyer sharp.
presets.not: Not cyberpunk: acid is flat-black, chrome and lime with flyer typography, not neon cities or HUD blue.

presets.name: Sticker bomb
presets.what: Die-cut stickers slapped at angles over an electric-blue field and a phone mockup, thick outlines, badges, stars and ratings.
presets.not: Not die-cut sticker illustration: a sticker bomb is about layered chaos of many stickers over the product.

presets.name: Oversized type
presets.what: Headline set enormous in condensed capitals on black, filling the frame edge to edge; one orange block and editorial rules.
presets.not: Not editorial layout: the type is the picture, not a headline over a story.

presets.name: High-contrast monochrome
presets.what: Black and white with charcoal: white hairline boxes, bold grotesk, no colour at all, film grain for bite.
presets.not: Not dark UI: there is no brand colour; contrast, charcoal and type do everything.

presets.name: Duotone
presets.what: Exactly two inks: electric blue and bubblegum pink, every shape, card and letter in one or the other, no third colour.
presets.not: Not gradient-heavy: the two colours never blend; each shape is one flat ink.

presets.name: Swiss punk (New Wave)
presets.what: Swiss grid broken apart: layered tilted slabs, halftone dot fields, mixed weights and rules colliding in black, orange and grey.
presets.not: Not Swiss International: same grotesk, but the grid is deliberately broken, layered and textured.

presets.name: Long-shadow flat
presets.what: Flat saturated tiles and white icons, each casting a long hard 45-degree shadow in a darker tone of the ground.
presets.not: Not material design: the shadow is a flat diagonal band, not soft elevation.

presets.name: Colour blocking
presets.what: Big borderless blocks of flat saturated colour butting together: tangerine ground, cobalt and blush pills, chunky geometric sans.
presets.not: Not neo-brutalism: no outlines or shadows; colour fields do the separating.

presets.name: Monospace brutalism
presets.what: Everything in monospace: white page, square black-bordered terminal, one safety-orange offset shadow, grid paper underneath.
presets.not: Not retro terminal: no green phosphor or CRT; it is a modern, stark print-like page in mono type.

presets.name: Anti-design
presets.what: Clashing lime and magenta, sketchy wobbling outlines, cheap pop-up windows, squiggles and a comic-ish face on purpose.
presets.not: Not raw brutalism: anti-design adds loud clashing colour and mess; raw brutalism is bare and colourless.

presets.name: Dark neo-brutalism
presets.what: Charcoal ground, bento tiles with thick white outlines and hard lime offset shadows, violet highlights, heavy grotesk.
presets.not: Not cyberpunk: flat solid shadows and thick outlines, no glow, gradients or HUD chrome.

presets.name: Industrial hazard
presets.what: Safety yellow and black, stencil-condensed capitals, double-ruled boxes, crosshair marks and data readouts like factory signage.
presets.not: Not sci-fi HUD: it is printed industrial signage, flat and heavy, not glowing screens.

presets.name: Op art
presets.what: Black-and-white radiating stripes that vibrate, a stark white star and heavy geometric caps; the pattern itself moves the eye.
presets.not: Not psychedelic: op art is strict black-and-white geometry, no melting colour.

presets.name: Main title sequence
presets.what: Widely tracked uppercase serif credits fading on near-black, warm gold hairlines, heavy film grain and long, patient holds.
presets.not: Not a trailer: slow fades and quiet holds instead of slams, and the type stays small and spaced.

presets.name: Film noir
presets.what: Stark black and white, venetian-blind light striping the frame, a heavy italic-free serif title and deep, smoky shadow.
presets.not: Not neo-noir: no neon or colour at all; drama comes from light and shadow alone.

presets.name: Blockbuster trailer
presets.what: Tall condensed uppercase slamming onto teal-black, orange light rays behind, lens noise; each card hits on a boom and cuts.
presets.not: Not a title sequence: loud, fast and percussive, built on hits and risers rather than holds.

presets.name: Vintage film titles
presets.what: Ornate display serif inside double-ruled frames on sepia, cream lettering, flickering grain and slow dissolves like a 1940s picture.
presets.not: Not Art Deco: the frame is a simple double rule and the mood is sepia film, not geometric gold.

presets.name: Documentary graphics
presets.what: Understated sans captions and figures over graded dark footage, one archival-yellow accent, a slow line chart and gentle grain.
presets.not: Not a news package: no banners or tickers; graphics are sparse and let the footage lead.

presets.name: Archival documentary
presets.what: Sepia photographs and clippings laid on aged paper, slow pans and push-ins, typewriter captions and faded brick-red annotation.
presets.not: Not scrapbook: the scraps are real archival records moved with slow camera, not decorative craft.

presets.name: Cinematic duotone
presets.what: Photography gradient-mapped to deep indigo and ember orange, washed panels, bright cream type and soft film grain.
presets.not: Not risograph: a smooth photographic gradient map in two colours, not overprinted spot inks.

presets.name: Minimal arthouse
presets.what: A centred lowercase title in a quiet sans on a bone-coloured still, wide empty margins, soft grain and long, patient dissolves.
presets.not: Not fashion editorial: small lowercase sans and muted stills, no Didone glamour.

presets.name: Sports broadcast
presets.what: Heavy condensed uppercase on stadium navy, stat tiles slamming in, taxi-yellow and red hits, hard shadows and hyper-fast wipes.
presets.not: Not a news package: louder, italic-energy type and stat tiles; everything wipes on the beat.

presets.name: Broadcast news package
presets.what: Deep navy studio gradients, breaking-news red bars, globe orbits, clean sans headlines and panels that slide in with authority.
presets.not: Not documentary graphics: branded bars, tickers and gradients announce themselves; nothing is understated.

presets.name: True-crime evidence board
presets.what: Cork wall, cream index cards pinned and joined by dashed red string, typewriter labels, one suspect card flagged in yellow.
presets.not: Not a flowchart explainer: a physical, messy detective wall with string and pins, not clean nodes.

presets.name: Dark atmospheric tech launch
presets.what: Product floats out of pure black, rim-lit in a violet glow, glass panels and giant tight sans; slow push-ins and drifting light.
presets.not: Not sci-fi HUD: no readouts or rings; just darkness, light and the product.

presets.name: Techno-thriller screen graphics
presets.what: A terminal in a dark room: cold white monospace typing, one alarm-red prompt, faint noise and cuts timed like a heist.
presets.not: Not the green-screen hacker terminal: cold white type and a red alarm accent, no phosphor glow or CRT; shot like a film insert.

presets.name: Motorsport telemetry
presets.what: Race-broadcast overlays on carbon black: rev-dial rings, live timing readouts, italic-energy caps in racing red and teal.
presets.not: Not a sci-fi HUD: grounded real-world telemetry (speed, laps, deltas) in broadcast colours, not fantasy interface.

presets.name: Symmetrical pastel
presets.what: Dead-centred symmetrical framing, candy pink and mustard pastels, uppercase geometric sans, flat whip pans and a storybook stillness.
presets.not: Not kawaii pastel: adult, deadpan and rigorously symmetrical, with film grain rather than cute characters.

presets.name: Neo-noir neon
presets.what: Wet night-black, a hot-pink neon-lit plate, cyan rim light, tracked uppercase sans and slow, humming drifts.
presets.not: Not cyberpunk: no grids, kanji or glitch; contemporary night-city light, sparse and slow.

presets.name: Flat infographic
presets.what: Bright flat colour tiles, bold filled pictograms, big numbers and simple bars; no gradients, no shadows, pure shape.
presets.not: Not data journalism: promotional and icon-led, not sourced charts with editorial type.

presets.name: Data journalism
presets.what: Salmon newsprint, serif headline, one precise line chart with sourced annotations, thin rules and a restrained two-colour series.
presets.not: Not a dashboard: one argued chart with a headline and a source line, not a panel of metrics.

presets.name: Dark ops dashboard
presets.what: Dense dark tiles edged in neon, big live numbers, status dots and mono labels; a wall of real-time metrics.
presets.not: Not dashboard showcase: dense, dark and operational, built for monitoring rather than marketing.

presets.name: Map explainer
presets.what: Pale land on a dot-matrix field, bold red markers and crosshairs pinning places, routes drawing on between them.

presets.name: Systems diagram
presets.what: Crisp labelled boxes and orthogonal arrows on white, monospace headings, one highlighted path pulsing through the system.
presets.not: Not node canvas: an explanatory figure with a fixed path, not an editable product canvas.

presets.name: Blueprint schematic
presets.what: White hairlines and dimension rings on Prussian-blue grid paper, stencil-mono labels, parts measured and annotated as they draw on.

presets.name: Whiteboard explainer
presets.what: Black and red marker lines drawing onto a white board, hand-lettered labels, wobbly boxes and doodle icons appearing stroke by stroke.
presets.not: Not chalk talk: bright white board with crisp marker, not dusty chalk on dark slate.

presets.name: Timeline explainer
presets.what: Milestone rows marching down a rail, green year dots, bold serif dates, each step sliding in as the story moves forward.

presets.name: Network graph
presets.what: Glowing pill nodes linked by fine lines on deep navy, orbit rings around clusters, links lighting up as relationships emerge.

presets.name: Academic explainer
presets.what: Cream page, classic serif set in two columns, a muted-teal figure plate, thin rules and footnote-sized captions.
presets.not: Not data journalism: bookish and figure-led, no newsroom headline energy.

presets.name: Isometric process
presets.what: Mint and coral blocks extruded with long flat diagonal shadows, a filled icon per step, a tidy stepwise process read left to right.

presets.name: Chalk talk
presets.what: Dusty chalk lines and hand-lettering on green-black slate, sketchy boxes and doodled arrows, smudged grain everywhere.

presets.name: Annotated screenshot
presets.what: A real screen framed in a window, bold red outlines, arrows and numbered callouts pointing at what matters, zooming into details.
presets.not: Not browser-framed UI: the markup is the point; red outlines and callouts sit on top of the product.

presets.name: Metric count-up
presets.what: One enormous condensed number ticking up beside a rising line, black on white, a single punchy orange for the delta.

presets.name: Financial terminal
presets.what: Amber and green monospace figures on black, dense tables and ticker lines, faint scanlines, zero decoration.
presets.not: Not terminal product demo: dense amber market data, not a sparse modern CLI.

presets.name: Explainer collage
presets.what: Torn paper, halftone photos and yellow highlighter blocks taped over charts: newsroom collage that argues a point.
presets.not: Not deconstructed UI: it collages print, photos and charts, not interface pieces.

presets.name: Scrollytelling story
presets.what: A vertical phone story on midnight navy: cream display-serif headline, one chart card per scroll step, a single hot-magenta highlight.

presets.name: Soft 3D
presets.what: Periwinkle and blush 3D orbs float beside rounded cards with big diffuse shadows and gradient-lit surfaces; springy, friendly, clean.
presets.not: Not clay: soft 3D is smooth and clean-lit; claymorphism is inflated, matte and puffy with inner highlights.

presets.name: Claymation 3D
presets.what: Hand-squished plasticine shapes in tomato, cobalt and mustard with fingerprint grain, squiggly clay snakes and stepped stop-motion timing.
presets.not: Not claymorphic UI: this is sculpted plasticine with fingerprints and stop-motion steps, not smooth puffy interface cards.

presets.name: Glossy 3D
presets.what: Wet-look candy-pink orbs with hard specular highlights and sparkles on blush, fat display type popping in with overshoot.
presets.not: Not soft 3D: glossy is high-gloss plastic with bright specular hits, not matte pastel forms.

presets.name: Chrome liquid metal
presets.what: Mirror-chrome pills with banded highlights on cool silver-white, steel sparkles and wide caps; surfaces feel poured and molten.
presets.not: Not Y2K chrome: no pink-cyan candy or retro techno; this is monochrome liquid metal, cool and molten.

presets.name: Glass 3D
presets.what: Translucent frosted-glass cards refract cyan and pink light behind them on deep navy; thin bright edges, big float shadows.
presets.not: Not spatial UI: glass 3D is about the material (refraction, light) rather than windows placed in a room.

presets.name: Low poly
presets.what: Faceted flat-shaded panels in sunset orange, amber and plum, sharp corners, hard offset facets and angular caps.
presets.not: Not isometric: low poly is about visible triangles and flat shading, not a fixed 30-degree grid.

presets.name: Isometric 3D
presets.what: Clean isometric blocks on a pale blue grid, long pale extrusion shadows, blue duotone icons, connectors sliding blocks into place.
presets.not: Not full 3D: isometric keeps a fixed orthographic angle with no perspective or camera moves.

presets.name: Tilt-shift diorama
presets.what: A tiny mint-green world of little rounded blocks, soft sunlit shadows and grain, like a model village shot with tilt-shift.
presets.not: Not isometric: dioramas use perspective and shallow focus to feel like a real miniature, not a flat 30-degree grid.

presets.name: Concrete brutalist 3D
presets.what: Raw grey concrete slabs and monoliths with heavy float shadows, pitted noise texture, one safety-orange accent and huge tight type.
presets.not: Not web brutalism: this is the material (poured concrete in 3D light), not raw HTML layouts.

presets.name: Surreal 3D
presets.what: Pastel peach dreamscape with arched forms, long soft shadows and slow orbiting objects; impossible, calm, cinematic.
presets.not: Not soft 3D product UI: surreal 3D is a scene, impossible architecture and objects, not floating interface cards.

presets.name: Photoreal product CGI
presets.what: The product alone on black under studio light, deep float shadow, tight grotesk type, one blue accent, nothing decorative.
presets.not: Not glossy 3D: photoreal aims for physical truth (real materials, studio light), not a stylized cartoon sheen.

presets.name: Paper-cut shadow box
presets.what: Deep navy and ember cut-paper layers stacked in a shadow box, each casting a dark offset shadow; fibre texture and parallax planes.
presets.not: Not soft paper layers: shadow box is deep, dark and dramatic with many stacked planes, not pastel sheets taped down.

presets.name: Gummy gel
presets.what: A phone full of translucent jelly-pink tiles glowing from within over bubblegum blobs; wet highlights, wobbly springs, squishy and edible.
presets.not: Not glass: gel is soft, colored and wobbly with inner glow, not rigid clear refraction.

presets.name: Liquid 3D
presets.what: Glossy fluid blobs pour and merge on electric cobalt, bright specular orbs, white type riding the flow with elastic springs.
presets.not: Not chrome liquid metal: this is colored fluid (water, paint, syrup), translucent and saturated, not a silver mirror.

presets.name: Voxel 3D
presets.what: Chunky cube-built tiles in grass green and wood brown under a sky blue, hard block shadows, pixel icons, stop-motion steps.
presets.not: Not pixel art: voxels are true 3D cubes with depth and shading, not flat 2D pixels.

presets.name: 3D wireframe mesh
presets.what: Thin dashed mesh-green lines on black, unfilled nodes and topology like a 3D viewport; objects build edge by edge.
presets.not: Not neon grid: no glow or light-cycle drama; it is the honest viewport mesh before shading.

presets.name: Point-cloud 3D
presets.what: Forms built from thousands of glowing points on black: star-field dots, a dotted 3D scatter and numbers resolving out of the particles.
presets.not: Not a wireframe mesh: point clouds have no edges, only points; shapes read by density.

presets.name: Toon-shaded 3D
presets.what: 3D forms flattened into two-tone cel shading with thick ink outlines, sky-blue ground, sharp shadow blocks in a darker hue.
presets.not: Not neo-brutalism: the shadow is a darker shade of the object (cel shading), not a black offset block.

presets.name: Exploded view 3D
presets.what: Product parts separated along axes on warm white, float shadows under each layer, crisp labels and leader lines.
presets.not: Not isometric: exploded views pull one object apart to show structure, usually with perspective and float.

presets.name: Prism crystal
presets.what: Sharp faceted panels on ink-violet split light into offset pink and cyan edges; hairline white rims and chromatic dispersion shimmer.
presets.not: Not glass 3D: prism is faceted and sharp, splitting light into color; glass 3D is smooth, frosted and soft.

presets.name: Tabloid front page
presets.what: A red masthead box, screaming condensed capitals, yellow flash callouts, boxed halftone photos and heavy black keylines.
presets.not: Not newspaper broadsheet: sensational rather than sober; red and yellow boxes, huge caps, almost no body text.

presets.name: Magazine serif editorial
presets.what: A feature spread in motion: masthead rule, high-contrast display serif headline, two justified columns and a photo well on warm paper.
presets.not: Not newspaper broadsheet: fewer columns, bigger serif, more air and one image carrying the page.

presets.name: Fashion editorial
presets.what: Towering uppercase Didone with hairline serifs, stark white page, a blush photo plate and wide-tracked captions; silence as luxury.
presets.not: Not fashion minimal: a full spread with a photo plate and captions, not a lone headline on white.

presets.name: Newspaper broadsheet
presets.what: Newsprint grey paper, bold condensed-serif headline, double-ruled borders, dense columns and a halftone photo; the press is running.
presets.not: Not magazine serif: denser, greyer, ruled into boxes, and the photo is a halftone.

presets.name: Graphic standards manual
presets.what: A 1970s identity manual: neutral grotesk, strict grid lines, specimen cards, measured red and black, and spec labels in small caps.
presets.not: Not Swiss poster style: the page is a rulebook, with specimens, grids and specs rather than a single expressive composition.

presets.name: Exhibition & wayfinding
presets.what: Museum signage in motion: dark gallery-green walls, rounded sign panels, clean neo-grotesk labels and arrow pictograms.
presets.not: Not a UI: the panels are signs, read at distance, with pictograms instead of controls.

presets.name: Classical book typography
presets.what: A clothbound classic: oxblood cover, centred old-style Garamond in cream, a gold fleuron, fine paper grain and unhurried fades.
presets.not: Not magazine serif: a single centred book-cover composition in old-style type, no columns or headline drama.

presets.name: Architectural monograph
presets.what: Concrete-grey pages, an oversized light-weight grotesk, plan crosshairs, captioned plates and captions set small; built like an architecture book.
presets.not: Not Swiss poster style: light weights, grey stone tones and photographic plates; quiet rather than assertive.

presets.name: Annual report
presets.what: Navy serif headlines, crisp sans figures, thin rules and one clean chart on bright paper; numbers presented as a story.
presets.not: Not a dashboard: one chart at a time, typeset like a printed page, no UI chrome.

presets.name: Art-direction moodboard
presets.what: Photos, swatches and a serif title card pinned edge to edge on a warm grey board, camel and olive tones, soft lifted shadows.
presets.not: Not scrapbook or zine: tidy, curated and photographic, with muted tones, no doodles or photocopy grit.

presets.name: Type specimen
presets.what: One typeface on show against black: a giant headline, glyph marks, crosshair registration and metric callouts in a single hot orange.
presets.not: Not kinetic typography in general: the letterforms themselves are the subject, measured and annotated.

presets.name: Social-first editorial
presets.what: A magazine told in vertical stories: huge serif cover lines on a black phone, film-grain photo panels and one coral highlight.
presets.not: Not scrollytelling: tap-through story frames with cover-line type, not a long read with charts.

presets.name: Editorial UI
presets.what: Product windows typeset like a magazine: serif headings, hairline borders, cream canvas, square corners and one deep green accent.
presets.not: Not SaaS minimal: serif type, visible rules and paper tones replace grey cards and blue buttons.

presets.name: Scientific journal
presets.what: Figure 1 of a paper: white page, serif captions, thin black boxes and arrows, numbered labels and one vermilion highlight.
presets.not: Not a whiteboard explainer: typeset and exact, like a printed figure, never hand-drawn.

presets.name: Editorial kinetic typography
presets.what: Huge tight serif headlines slam across a saturated vermilion field, word by word; black type, no images, pure hierarchy.
presets.not: Not a type specimen: the words carry a message; the typeface is a voice, not the subject.

presets.name: Photo essay
presets.what: A large moody photograph dominates a dark spread, with a restrained sans headline, italic caption and film grain on charcoal.
presets.not: Not documentary film: still photography composed on a page, captions typeset, no lower thirds.

presets.name: Contemporary grotesk editorial
presets.what: Heavy uppercase grotesk in rounded modular tiles, pale grey page, black and one acid-lime tile; today's design-studio layout.
presets.not: Not Swiss International Style: rounded tiles, heavier uppercase type and a fashionable acid accent instead of red.

presets.name: Illustrated editorial
presets.what: A conceptual spot illustration in grainy flat colour, muted ochre and teal on off-white, crowned by a calm serif headline.
presets.not: Not flat corporate illustration: textured, conceptual and restrained, drawn like a magazine commission.

presets.name: Deconstructed editorial
presets.what: The grid breaks: condensed type overlapping and jittering, torn noise, off-kilter callouts, dirty black and a sodium-yellow hit.
presets.not: Not Photocopy zine: no taped scraps; the typography itself is fractured and layered on screen.

presets.name: Screenplay page
presets.what: A shooting-script page: Courier Prime on cream bond, sluglines and dialogue typing out, red-pencil revisions and a soft page shadow.
presets.not: Not letterpress or monospace brutalism: script formatting on a lifted paper page, typed live, no deboss and no hard borders.

presets.name: Tactical HUD
presets.what: Night-vision green reticles, range ladders and dashed bracket frames over near-black; blocky caps and numbers that snap between readings.
presets.not: Not cinematic FUI: tactical HUDs are sparse, green and functional, built for a gunsight or drone feed, not a hero's glass screen.
search: night vision drone feed motion graphics

presets.name: Cyberpunk neon
presets.what: Acid-yellow window chrome and red hard offsets on violet-black, angular Orbitron caps, scanlines and glitching cyber-deck panels.
presets.not: Not neo-noir neon: cyberpunk is acid yellow and red UI chrome, dense and aggressive, not moody pink glow in the rain.

presets.name: Holographic iridescent
presets.what: Pearly lavender, mint and pink shifting across soft tiles like holographic foil, with grain and slow shimmering drifts.
presets.not: Not AI aurora: aurora is dark with glowing blurred light; holographic is light, pearly and foil-like.

presets.name: Blueprint technical
presets.what: White dashed linework and monospaced labels on cobalt blueprint grid, red-pencil markups; boxes, dimension lines and connectors draw themselves on.
presets.not: Not wireframe UI: blueprint is an engineering drawing, blue ground and white line, not a grey app mockup.

presets.name: AR overlay
presets.what: Translucent white pill labels and thin reticles pinned onto a live camera view, tracking objects in space with soft springs.
presets.not: Not a sci-fi HUD: AR overlays are light, minimal labels anchored to the real world, not a cinematic instrument panel.

presets.name: Dark dev-tool
presets.what: Near-black tiles with hairline borders, one indigo accent, tight grotesk type and a faint grid; restrained, exact, quietly premium.
presets.not: Not terminal hacker: no green phosphor or console cosplay; this is a polished product UI in dark mode.

presets.name: AI aurora gradient
presets.what: Violet and cyan light blooms through a dark field behind a calm headline; grain, glowing edges and a slow breathing fade.
presets.not: Not holographic: aurora is dark and luminous, soft blurred light, not a pearly foil surface.

presets.name: Circuit board (PCB)
presets.what: Gold traces and solder pads run across solder-mask green; square chips with copper outlines, stencil-mono labels, stepped signal pulses.
presets.not: Not blueprint: PCB is a physical board, green mask and gold copper, not a white-line drawing.

presets.name: Orbital space
presets.what: Deep-space black, elliptical orbit paths and a single signal-orange accent; wide extended caps and slow weightless drift.
presets.not: Not sci-fi HUD: fewer instruments, more void; the orbit and the scale carry it.

presets.name: Glitch digital
presets.what: Black panels torn by cyan and magenta RGB-split offsets, pixel icons and digital noise; frames stutter, slice and jump.
presets.not: Not VHS retro: glitch is digital corruption (pixels, RGB offsets), not analog tape wobble.

presets.name: Data noir
presets.what: Black page, hard white type, thin rules and one blood-red accent; columns of figures and a stark headline wipe in.
presets.not: Not dark dev-tool: no product UI; this is editorial journalism, rules and numbers, in the dark.

presets.name: Code editor dark theme
presets.what: A floating dark-theme code window with pink, green and violet syntax highlighting, ligature mono type and lines typing themselves out.
presets.not: Not a retro green-screen terminal: it is a modern editor theme, colorful syntax on soft dark, no CRT nostalgia.

presets.name: Mission control
presets.what: Graphite panels with recessed wells, amber telemetry numbers and cyan trend lines on a module grid; everything snaps to live values.
presets.not: Not sci-fi HUD: mission control is a working console (panels, numbers, charts), not cinematic linework.

presets.name: Biotech clean
presets.what: Clinical off-white, teal and aqua pill nodes linked like molecules, soft shadows and orbital rings; calm, sterile, trustworthy.
presets.not: Not generic SaaS minimal: the molecular nodes, orbits and clinical teal make it read as the lab.

presets.name: Neon wireframe grid
presets.what: Glowing cyan outlines on a black grid world; pill controls lit like light-cycles with orange sparks of accent.
presets.not: Not synthwave: no sunset, palm trees or chrome; just lit vectors on a black grid.

presets.name: Industrial mecha UI
presets.what: Warning-yellow blocks and hard offset shadows on gunmetal, condensed heavy caps, warning glyphs and stamped numerals that slam into place.
presets.not: Not sci-fi HUD: this is heavy, blocky and industrial; no thin glowing lines.

presets.name: Web3 crypto dark
presets.what: A glowing phone wallet on ink-black, acid-lime accents on gradient cards, confident geometric type and quick springy counters.
presets.not: Not cyberpunk: cleaner, app-first and optimistic; neon is an accent on product UI, not an atmosphere.

presets.name: Technical minimalism
presets.what: Warm grey panels with black outlines, one signal-orange accent, mono labels, crosshair registration marks and dot-matrix texture; tool-like and exact.
presets.not: Not Swiss minimal: it borrows instrument panels (labels, markings, knobs), not a typographic grid.

presets.name: Neural node graph
presets.what: Frosted violet nodes connected by lines on deep indigo, soft glow and dot field; signals travel node to node.
presets.not: Not blueprint: dark and luminous with glass nodes, about intelligence and flow, not engineering drawings.

presets.name: Solarpunk
presets.what: Sunlit cream, leaf green and solar gold tiles with rounded corners, sun-ray motifs and grain; technology that grows rather than glows.
presets.not: Not organic wellness: solarpunk keeps the tech (panels, data, systems) and frames it as an optimistic future.

presets.name: Doodle
presets.what: Wobbly hand-drawn outlines, offset doodle icons and squiggles on white cards, loose marker handwriting.
presets.not: Not neo-brutalism: no hard block shadows or heavy frames; the lines themselves wobble and wiggle.

presets.name: Sketchbook
presets.what: Graphite-grey pencil lines and notes on toothy off-white paper, thin sketchy frames, a single coloured-pencil accent.
presets.not: Not doodle: sketchbook is observational and tonal in pencil, not bold cartoon doodles.

presets.name: Ink & marker
presets.what: Fat black marker strokes and all-caps marker lettering on white, one red highlight, loose scribbled emphasis.
presets.not: Not brush lettering: the stroke is an even, round felt-tip line, not a tapered brush.

presets.name: Watercolour wash
presets.what: Soft bleeding watercolour blobs in pastel sage, peach and blue on cold-press paper, no outlines, gentle handwritten type.
presets.not: Not pastel flat vector: the colour pools and bleeds with paper grain; edges are soft, not crisp.

presets.name: Paper cutout
presets.what: Flat coloured paper shapes stacked in layers with small soft shadows between them, visible fibre, no outlines.
presets.not: Not scrapbook collage: pieces are cleanly cut shapes in a tidy layout, no tape, photos or found scraps.

presets.name: Scrapbook collage
presets.what: Tilted paper scraps held by washi tape, typewriter labels and stickers, pastel paper stock with fibre texture.
presets.not: Not punk zine: scrapbook is soft, pastel and affectionate; zines are black-and-white photocopy and loud.

presets.name: Cut-and-paste zine
presets.what: Black-and-white photocopied scraps pasted crooked, ransom-note type, halftone dots and one hot-pink spot colour.
presets.not: Not scrapbook: harsh xerox contrast and aggression, not pastel keepsakes.

presets.name: Risograph
presets.what: Fluoro pink and blue inks overprinting on cream stock, slightly misregistered, grainy dot texture, chunky grotesk.
presets.not: Not screen print: riso is grainy, translucent and slightly off-register, not dense opaque layers.

presets.name: Screen print
presets.what: Three flat opaque inks on kraft stock, heavy slab display type, halftone shading and bold sunburst rays.
presets.not: Not risograph: screen print is dense, opaque and poster-sized, not grainy translucent overprint.

presets.name: Linocut
presets.what: Rough carved black shapes with gouged edges and one red ink on warm off-white, woodtype caps and uneven ink texture.
presets.not: Not screen print: marks are carved and chiselled with rough edges, not flat halftone layers.

presets.name: Stop-motion paper
presets.what: Cardboard-cut cards that jitter in on twos with real drop shadows, hand-cut edges and visible frame-to-frame boil.
presets.not: Not paper cutout illustration: the difference is motion; pieces step and boil at 12 fps like real stop-motion.

presets.name: Chalkboard
presets.what: Dusty chalk-white lettering and hand-drawn charts on slate green, yellow and pink chalk accents, smudged texture.
presets.not: Not whiteboard animation: dark board, dusty chalk texture and pastel chalk colours, not clean marker on white.

presets.name: Crayon childlike
presets.what: Waxy primary-colour crayon scribbles on white paper, lopsided stars, uneven kid lettering and thick wobbly outlines.
presets.not: Not doodle: crayon is waxy, filled-in and naive, drawn like a child rather than a designer.

presets.name: Hand-lettered script
presets.what: One big flowing script headline with a swash underline on warm cream, deep burgundy ink, tiny spaced caps below.
presets.not: Not marker: lettering is drawn with thick-thin contrast and swashes, not an even felt-tip line.

presets.name: Bullet journal
presets.what: Dot-grid paper with neat handwritten boxes, dashed trackers, pastel highlighter tabs and tiny doodle icons.
presets.not: Not sketchbook: tidy dot-grid planning with highlighter colour, not loose pencil sketches.

presets.name: Letterpress & typewriter
presets.what: Typewriter and wood type pressed into thick cotton paper, debossed inset panels, a single red ink and hairline rules.
presets.not: Not editorial print: the ink bites into the paper; depth is an impression, not a layout grid.

presets.name: Ink brush (sumi-e)
presets.what: Expressive black brush strokes on rice paper, lots of empty space, a small vermilion seal, dry-brush edges.
presets.not: Not marker: strokes swell and taper and break into dry brush; emptiness matters as much as ink.

presets.name: Felt & stitch
presets.what: Soft puffy felt patches with dashed running-stitch edges, woolly texture, warm crafty colours and rounded chunky type.
presets.not: Not claymorphism: the texture is fibrous fabric and the edges are stitched, not smooth plastic clay.

presets.name: Hand-drawn wireframe
presets.what: Sketchy black-outlined app windows and buttons on graph paper, handwritten labels, grey fills and one blue highlight.
presets.not: Not a clean wireframe UI: lines wobble and labels are handwritten, like a marker sketch of an app.

presets.name: Whiteboard animation
presets.what: Black marker diagrams drawn live on a bright whiteboard, boxes and arrows linking ideas, one blue and one red marker.
presets.not: Not chalkboard: clean marker on white, drawn as you watch, focused on the logic of a diagram.

presets.name: Black and gold
presets.what: Near-black panels hairlined and haloed in warm gold, engraved wide-tracked capitals, a gold ornament, film grain, slow fades.
presets.not: Not a film title sequence: gold frames and panels carry the brand, not just credits floating on black.

presets.name: Maison sans
presets.what: A wide-tracked geometric sans wordmark in black on stark white, nothing else, snapping in with hard masked wipes like a runway card.
presets.not: Not a Didone fashion editorial: the voice is a tracked geometric sans wordmark, the stripped 'blanded' look of modern luxury houses.

presets.name: Perfume-ad noir
presets.what: Aubergine darkness, a rose-gold glint, soft-lit italic serif and one slow drifting glow, like a fragrance commercial end card.
presets.not: Not black and gold: warmer and more sensual, lit by a rose glow and italics rather than engraved capitals and gold frames.

presets.name: Luxury serif minimal
presets.what: A light Garamond line centred on ivory with one hairline icon, taupe accents, immense margins and unhurried fades.
presets.not: Not warm minimalism: colder and more formal, hairlines instead of blocks, a classical Garamond rather than a soft serif.

presets.name: Wabi-sabi luxe
presets.what: Plaster-coloured tiles on aged limewash, sumi-black Mincho type, one umber accent, raw grain and long, patient fades.
presets.not: Not quiet luxury: the restraint is Japanese and material, rough plaster and ink with asymmetry, not tonal beige status.

presets.name: Jewelry macro
presets.what: Polished platinum cards glinting on midnight navy, star-shaped sparkles, ice-blue glow, slow macro-like drift.
presets.not: Not chrome Y2K: cool and restrained, polished metal with pinpoint sparkle, no rainbow reflections or bubbly type.

presets.name: Architectural minimal
presets.what: Concrete grey ground ruled by a faint construction grid, sharp-cornered planes, a slim grotesk and a single stone-coloured block.
presets.not: Not brutalism: no raw type or clashing colour; the grid, concrete and sharp planes are disciplined and quiet.

presets.name: Quiet luxury
presets.what: Camel, oat and cashmere-beige pills with whisper-soft shadows, no logos or gold, a restrained thin serif, barely-there motion.
presets.not: Not warm minimalism: no terracotta or craft; it is tonal beige-on-beige that signals wealth by what it leaves out.

presets.name: Champagne
presets.what: Pale champagne ground, cards washed in ivory-to-gold gradient, a soft-lit phone, fine sparkles, elegant serif, gentle rising motion.
presets.not: Not black and gold: light and bubbly, a pale gold gradient on ivory rather than gold on darkness.

presets.name: Editorial couture
presets.what: Tilted oxblood and blush fashion-plate panels on off-white, an italic Didone headline, film grain, cuts timed like a lookbook.
presets.not: Not fashion minimal: layered and image-led, with overlapping panels and tape, rather than a single word on white.

presets.name: Horological precision
presets.what: Gold dial rings, indices and a sweeping hand on deep navy, engraved serif caps, tiny numerals, a mechanically smooth second-hand glide.
presets.not: Not sci-fi HUD: the rings are a watch face in gold on navy, calm and classical, not a neon targeting overlay.

presets.name: Private banking
presets.what: Deep navy panels with a thin gold performance line, a large serif figure, measured grid, and soft shadows: trust rendered as calm.
presets.not: Not a SaaS dashboard: sparse, serif-led and slow, with one metric and one line, not a crowded widget grid.

presets.name: Stealth tech luxe
presets.what: Matte graphite windows with hairline aluminium edges floating over black, wide-tracked light capitals, fine line icons, machined precision.
presets.not: Not a sci-fi interface: no neon or glow, just metal, graphite and restraint, like a product photograph set in motion.

presets.name: Marble and gold
presets.what: Veined white-marble ground, ivory tiles edged in thin brushed gold, a classical Roman serif and slow, polished reveals.
presets.not: Not luxury serif minimal: the marble veining and gilt edges make it ornamental and material, not just typographic.

presets.name: Velvet jewel-tone
presets.what: Deep burgundy velvet ground, a heavy Playfair headline in cream, a gold panel and fine column rules, like an opera programme.
presets.not: Not perfume noir: this is printed and structured, columns and rules in jewel tones, not a single glowing end card.

presets.name: Heritage monogram
presets.what: Tobacco-brown panels on a repeating monogram dot pattern, cream glyph emblems, stitched-leather edges, a stately serif.
presets.not: Not quiet luxury: loud about its lineage, with a repeating monogram, emblems and leather, rather than logo-free beige.

presets.name: Luxury automotive reveal
presets.what: Near-black stage, hairline spec callouts linking graphite nodes, one signal-red accent, extended caps and long, weighted glides.
presets.not: Not stealth tech luxe: this is a spec reveal with a hot accent and connectors, about power and engineering, not a quiet object.

presets.name: Satin noir
presets.what: Dark pewter pills with a satin gradient sheen, big soft drop shadows, pearl-white thin serif, slow silky slides.
presets.not: Not dark neumorphism: the sheen is a directional satin gradient that floats, not a matte panel pushed out of the canvas.

presets.name: Kawaii
presets.what: Soft pink and mint pastels, round everything, thin cocoa outlines, blushing icons and sparkles, gentle bouncy entrances.
presets.not: Not generic pastel: kawaii is about cuteness cues (faces, blush, sparkles, tiny proportions), not just soft colour.

presets.name: Saturday-morning cartoon
presets.what: Sunburst rays, fat black outlines, squash-and-stretch type in a chunky cartoon face, bright orange and sky blue, springy overshoot.
presets.not: Not comic-book: cartoon is animated TV language (rays, squash and stretch), not printed panels and halftone.

presets.name: Toy-like 3D
presets.what: Chunky inflated plastic tiles with inner highlights, glossy 3D icon blobs, big soft drop shadows, candy primaries on sky blue.
presets.not: Not claymorphism: toy 3D is shiny, saturated plastic; clay is matte, pastel and soft.

presets.name: Memphis
presets.what: Squiggles, dots and confetti shapes in pink, teal and yellow, cut-out panels at jaunty angles with black outlines and hard shadows.
presets.not: Not Bauhaus: Memphis is patterned, pastel-meets-loud and deliberately off-balance.

presets.name: Die-cut stickers
presets.what: Every element is a glossy sticker with a thick white die-cut border and soft shadow, slapped onto a denim-blue board.
presets.not: Not sticker bomb: here each sticker is placed cleanly as a hero, not piled into chaos.

presets.name: Comic book
presets.what: Panels with inked outlines on halftone, starburst accents, red and cyan, punchy all-caps lettering like a Sunday comic.
presets.not: Not pop art: comic book tells a story in panels with lettering and action; pop art is a single ironic image.

presets.name: Mascot-led
presets.what: A friendly brand character guides the frame: rounded cards on soft grass green, wobbly doodle icons, warm type, springy acting.
presets.not: Not cartoon: the mascot is the brand's host inside product UI, not a TV show world.

presets.name: Kids edutainment
presets.what: Crayon-bright primaries on lined-paper cream, rounded step nodes joined by dashed paths, big friendly rounded type, gold stars.
presets.not: Not childlike doodle: it is organised for learning (steps, paths, rewards), not scribbly art.

presets.name: Gamified UI
presets.what: Chunky raised buttons, XP counters and streak charts in owl green and flame orange, heavy rounded type, celebratory confetti.
presets.not: Not arcade pixel style: gamified UI is a modern app with game rewards, not a retro game screen.

presets.name: Preschool TV
presets.what: Big simple shapes in sunshine yellow, tomato and grass, fat rounded cards in a chunky phone, no outlines, slow happy bounces.
presets.not: Not kawaii: preschool is bold primary simplicity for toddlers; kawaii is pastel cuteness for teens and adults.

presets.name: Emoji pop
presets.what: Glossy 3D emoji-like balls bouncing over lilac pill controls, soft glows, rounded geometric type, reactions popping in.
presets.not: Not toy-like 3D: only the emoji are 3D; the UI stays flat and light.

presets.name: Confetti party
presets.what: Confetti raining over deep party purple, a gold star, big rounded headline in shiny candy colours, popping entrances.
presets.not: Not gamified UI: confetti party is a one-off celebration card, not an app reward system.

presets.name: Playful tech
presets.what: A rounded pastel terminal with thick violet outline and hard shadow, peach canvas, sparkles, friendly geometric mono type.
presets.not: Not monospace brutalism: rounded, pastel and cheerful rather than stark and square.

presets.name: Candy desktop
presets.what: Pastel pop-up windows with bubblegum title bars, thick outlines and double offset shadows, doodle icons on a dotted mint desktop.
presets.not: Not retro OS: the windows are invented candy-coloured toys, not a faithful Windows 95 or Mac OS copy.

presets.name: Arcade game
presets.what: Pixel-font score readouts and pixel hearts on a dark cabinet screen, magenta and lime HUD rings, scanlines and stepped motion.
presets.not: Not gamified UI: this is the look of the game screen itself, pixels and scanlines, not a modern app.

presets.name: Activity book
presets.what: A kids-magazine spread: marker-drawn headline, ruled columns, one big tomato panel, sketchy outlines and doodles on grid paper.
presets.not: Not editorial: the same magazine structure, but handwritten, doodled and made for kids.

presets.name: Chibi anime pop
presets.what: Cel-flat anime pastels: lavender and hot pink tiles with crisp outlines, sparkle bursts, rounded Japanese-pop type, snappy pops.
presets.not: Not kawaii: chibi anime is saturated, cel-shaded and dramatic, with sparkle and speed effects.

presets.name: Rainbow glitter
presets.what: Hot pink ground, rainbow-washed cards with violet glow, swoopy script headline, glitter grain and sparkle stars everywhere.
presets.not: Not kawaii: rainbow glitter is saturated and maximal, glowing and sparkly, not soft pastel understatement.

presets.name: Board game
presets.what: Chunky board spaces on a cardboard game board joined by a path, red and blue pieces, hard drop shadows, stepped moves.
presets.not: Not a flowchart: the steps read as game spaces and tokens, turn by turn, with toy-like depth.

presets.name: Squishy blobs
presets.what: Wobbly gradient blobs drifting behind soft gradient pills in tangerine and violet, gooey rounded type, elastic squash on entry.
presets.not: Not inflated balloon: blobs are free-form and fluid, not puffy air-filled pills.

presets.name: Keynote hero
presets.what: One oversized device floats on a pure-black stage under soft light, huge tight white headline, a single blue accent, nothing else.
presets.not: Not dark gradient SaaS: no glow or colour wash; the product sits alone on true black, lit like a physical object.

presets.name: Dark gradient SaaS
presets.what: Near-black canvas, app windows lit by a violet gradient glow, hairline borders, tight grey-white type, fine noise.
presets.not: Not keynote hero: the light comes from gradient glows and hairlines inside the UI, not a spotlit object.

presets.name: Light editorial SaaS
presets.what: Crisp white page, deep navy type set like a magazine with rules and columns, one saturated gradient block, generous whitespace.
presets.not: Not calm productivity: sharp, grid-led and gradient-accented, not warm paper and slow serif calm.

presets.name: Bento showcase
presets.what: Features packed into a tight grid of rounded white tiles on light grey, each tile one stat, icon or screenshot, revealed in sequence.
presets.not: Not dashboard showcase: tiles are curated feature moments, not live metrics.

presets.name: Floating-card UI
presets.what: The interface broken into independent white cards hovering over a pale tinted field, deep soft drop shadows, cards drifting at different depths.
presets.not: Not bento: cards float freely at depth with parallax, not locked into a grid.

presets.name: Exploded UI
presets.what: One app window separates into stacked offset layers, each edged in a bright accent, revealing its structure like an exploded technical view.
presets.not: Not deconstructed UI: layers stay aligned on one axis; nothing is scattered.

presets.name: Oversized UI
presets.what: A single toggle, cursor or button blown up to poster scale on a saturated field, filling the frame like a graphic shape.
presets.not: Not component spec close-up: scale is the joke here; the control becomes a poster graphic, not a measured detail.

presets.name: Command-palette UI
presets.what: A single floating search bar on a dim canvas, keystrokes typing in, results snapping into place beside key-cap glyphs.

presets.name: Dashboard showcase
presets.what: A clean light analytics view: one hero line chart in a white panel, a big KPI number, faint grid, calm blue-and-green series.
presets.not: Not dark ops dashboard: bright product-marketing polish with one hero chart, not a dense wall of metrics.

presets.name: App Store promo
presets.what: A phone floats on a warm peach field, glossy 3D icons and rating stickers pop around it, each screen springing into place.
presets.not: Not calm productivity: loud, sticker-happy and springy where that one is quiet and slow.

presets.name: Browser-framed UI
presets.what: The product shown inside tidy browser windows with traffic-light chrome on a dotted neutral backdrop, cursor-led, soft realistic shadows.

presets.name: Component spec close-up
presets.what: One button, toggle or input magnified on a dark dot grid with crosshair registration marks, hairline outlines, measured motion.
presets.not: Not oversized UI: a measured close-up with spec marks, not a poster-scale gag.

presets.name: Fintech trust
presets.what: Brushed-metal card surfaces over warm stone, deep navy serif headlines, one money-green accent; calm, weighty, nothing flashy.
presets.not: Not luxury: it still shows real balances and cards; restraint serves trust, not status.

presets.name: Terminal product demo
presets.what: Pure-black stage, one crisp terminal window with a hairline border, monospace commands typing in, a single mint success glow.
presets.not: Not financial terminal: sparse, modern and glowing, not a dense amber data screen.

presets.name: Developer docs
presets.what: A light documentation page: white canvas, grey code blocks with hairline borders, blue links, monospace snippets, tidy and literal.
presets.not: Not terminal product demo: bright and instructional; it teaches the code rather than shows off the tool.

presets.name: AI chat product
presets.what: Prompt bars and answer bubbles on a warm off-white page, text streaming in, a violet-to-cyan sparkle marking the AI.

presets.name: Calm productivity
presets.what: A phone app on warm paper, serif headline, soft neutral rows, one gentle ochre accent, slow unhurried dissolves.

presets.name: Widget-first UI
presets.what: Chunky rounded widgets on a dark home-screen field: vivid colour tiles, big glanceable numbers, glossy 3D icons springing in.
presets.not: Not bento showcase: dark, native and toy-bright; tiles are live widgets, not marketing panels.

presets.name: Automotive HMI
presets.what: A charcoal cockpit screen with thin cyan gauges and rings, condensed uppercase readouts, restrained glow: shipping hardware, not sci-fi.
presets.not: Not sci-fi HUD: fewer brackets, no noise or glitch; every gauge reads like a real product.

presets.name: Node canvas
presets.what: Rounded nodes wired by dashed connectors on a dotted infinite canvas, data pulses travelling link to link.
presets.not: Not systems diagram: it is the product's own editable canvas, with cursors and drag, not an explanatory figure.

presets.name: Deconstructed UI
presets.what: A familiar screen broken into its buttons, cards and labels, scattered at angles with tape and hard shadows, then snapping back together.
presets.not: Not exploded UI: pieces scatter freely and rotate; there is no single stacking axis.

presets.name: Spatial glass UI
presets.what: Frosted translucent panels hover over a deep blurred colour field, soft light edges, gentle parallax depth.
presets.not: Not floating-card UI: panels are see-through glass in dark space, not opaque white cards on a pale field.

presets.name: Wireframe UI
presets.what: Grey boxes, dashed outlines and placeholder bars on a faint grid: the product sketched as structure before pixels.
presets.not: Not blueprint schematic: neutral greys and UI placeholders, not white-on-blue technical drawing.

presets.name: Windows 95
presets.what: Grey beveled windows with navy title bars and square _ □ × buttons on a teal desktop, pixel type and chunky pixel icons.
presets.not: Not vaporwave: the OS here is played straight, no pink gradients, busts or irony.

presets.name: Classic Mac 1-bit
presets.what: Pure black-and-white 1-bit desktop: dithered grey pattern, square windows with hard black drop shadows, bitmap type.
presets.not: Not Windows 95: no colour and no bevels; every pixel is black or white and depth is a hard drop shadow.

presets.name: Windows XP Luna
presets.what: Glossy royal-blue title bars and rounded window tops over a Bliss-sky gradient, cheerful green accents and soft drop shadows.
presets.not: Not Windows 95: XP is colourful, glossy and rounded where 95 is grey and square.

presets.name: Mac OS X Aqua
presets.what: Glossy blue gel pill buttons with wet highlights on pale pinstripe grey, lozenge controls and soft shadows.
use: app launches with a nostalgic wink
presets.not: Not Y2K chrome: Aqua is translucent blue gel and pinstripes, not silver metal and sparkles.

presets.name: Y2K chrome
presets.what: Liquid-silver chrome cards and wide techno type on icy blue, pink and cyan highlights, four-point sparkles everywhere.
presets.not: Not Frutiger Aero: Y2K is metallic and techno; Aero is glassy, sky-blue and nature-clean.

presets.name: Frutiger Aero
presets.what: Glossy translucent glass tiles over sky blue and grass green, bubbles and light blooms, clean humanist sans.
presets.not: Not modern glassmorphism: Aero is saturated sky-and-grass, glossy highlights and bubbles, not muted frosted panels.

presets.name: Vaporwave
aka: A E S T H E T I C
presets.what: Pastel pink-to-cyan collage of old OS windows and cut-out scraps, wide-spaced serif caps, scanlines and a perspective grid.
presets.not: Not synthwave: vaporwave is pastel, ironic and collaged; synthwave is dark, neon and sincere.

presets.name: Synthwave
presets.what: Hot-pink and cyan neon tube type glowing over a dark purple night, a perspective laser grid and sunset rays.
presets.not: Not cyberpunk: synthwave is 80s sunset nostalgia; cyberpunk is gritty, dystopian and data-heavy.

presets.name: 70s groovy
presets.what: Fat swashy bubble type in orange, mustard and brown on warm cream, sunburst rays and a soft film grain.
presets.not: Not 60s mid-century: groovy is fat, curvy and warm-brown; mid-century is geometric, atomic and flat.

presets.name: Mid-century modern
presets.what: Flat teal, mustard and tomato shapes in a loose editorial grid, atomic starbursts, geometric sans and printed grain.
presets.not: Not 70s groovy: mid-century is flat, angular and restrained, with atomic stars instead of fat curves.

presets.name: Art deco
presets.what: Gold double rules and sunburst fans on deep green-black, symmetrical centred layout, tall geometric display caps.
presets.not: Not luxury minimal: deco is ornamental, symmetrical and gold-lined, not quiet whitespace.

presets.name: 8-bit pixel art
presets.what: Chunky pixel icons, blocky arcade type and hard square shadows on a flat sky-blue, tiled like a game menu.
presets.not: Not Game Boy: 8-bit is full NES colour; Game Boy is four shades of green.

presets.name: Game Boy green
presets.what: Four shades of pea-soup green only, a handheld screen frame, pixel type and an LCD dot grid.
presets.not: Not 8-bit pixel art: strictly four greens, like the original LCD, no full colour.

presets.name: Green-screen CRT terminal
presets.what: Glowing phosphor-green monospace on black, curved-tube vignette, scanlines, a blinking block cursor typing line by line.
presets.not: Not a modern terminal UI: the whole frame is the old tube, with glow, curvature and scanlines.

presets.name: DOS text mode
presets.what: White and yellow monospace on electric DOS blue, boxy text-mode panels with double-line borders, square and flat.
presets.not: Not the green CRT: text mode is flat, blue and panel-based with no glow or tube curvature.

presets.name: Teletext
presets.what: Eight flat broadcast colours on black, blocky mosaic charts and bars, pixel headline bands, no curves anywhere.
presets.not: Not 8-bit game art: teletext is a flat information page in eight fixed colours, not sprites.

presets.name: VHS camcorder
presets.what: On-screen-display readouts like PLAY and a timestamp over dim tape footage, tracking scanlines, RGB split and glitch jumps.
presets.not: Not film grain cinema: this is consumer tape, with OSD text, colour bleed and tracking errors.

presets.name: Early iPhone skeuomorphism
presets.what: Glossy app icons and brushed-metal bars in a phone, linen-textured backgrounds, embossed type and soft realistic shadows.
presets.not: Not neumorphism: this imitates real materials (metal, linen, glass), not soft extruded plastic.

presets.name: 90s rave flyer
presets.what: Acid yellow, magenta and cyan on black, shaded 3D display type, halftone dots and stacked colour offsets in dense tiles.
presets.not: Not synthwave: rave flyers are fluoro, dense and xeroxed, not smooth neon sunsets.

presets.name: 70s airline modernism
presets.what: Crisp grotesk on cream, bold red and navy stripes, route-map nodes and connectors, orderly Swiss-grid information design.
presets.not: Not modern Swiss minimal: warm cream paper, livery stripes and jet-age optimism, not white SaaS.

presets.name: Web 1.0 homepage
presets.what: Times headings and bright yellow text on a starry navy tile, beveled table borders, hit-counter energy and pixel GIF icons.
presets.not: Not vaporwave: Web 1.0 is sincere amateur HTML, not a pastel ironic collage.

presets.name: Space-age retro-futurism
presets.what: Rounded cream cards orbited by elliptical atom rings, boomerang-orange and teal, bouncy rounded display type.
presets.not: Not synthwave: this is the 1950s imagining tomorrow, cream daylight and atoms, not 80s neon night.

presets.name: Neumorphism
presets.what: Controls extruded from a same-colour pale grey-blue canvas by a paired light and dark shadow; no outlines, one quiet accent.
presets.not: Not claymorphism: nothing is inflated or coloured; surfaces are the canvas itself, pushed up by light.

presets.name: Dark neumorphism
presets.what: Charcoal soft UI: panels and keys pushed out of a graphite canvas by faint rim light, with one mint accent glowing through.
presets.not: Not dark glassmorphism: nothing is translucent; the panels are solid graphite shaped only by highlight and shade.

presets.name: Pressed soft UI
presets.what: Warm stone panels carved into the canvas with inner shadows, charts sitting in debossed wells, a single terracotta data line.
presets.not: Not neumorphism's extruded look: here everything is pressed in, like a stamped tray, not raised.

presets.name: Material You
presets.what: Tonal lavender and rose containers with big 28px corners, no shadows, filled icons, a wallpaper-derived palette and springy shape morphs.
presets.not: Not claymorphism: surfaces are flat tonal fills with no highlights or drop shadows; the softness is colour and corner radius.

presets.name: Marshmallow 3D flat
presets.what: Pillowy peach, mint and cream tiles with soft inner highlights in a bento grid, glossy bead icons, rounded chunky type.
presets.not: Not claymorphism's floating cards: tiles sit snug in a grid like pillows, with barely any drop shadow.

presets.name: Pastel minimal
presets.what: One centred line of type on a milk-white field, a two-tone blush and powder-blue icon, tiny sparkles, lots of air.
presets.not: Not kawaii: no faces or mascots; the softness is colour and space, not character.

presets.name: Warm minimalism
presets.what: Oat and linen neutrals, a soft serif headline, a terracotta block, fine grain, generous margins and slow sliding reveals.
presets.not: Not quiet luxury: warmer and more human, with a friendly soft serif and earth colour, not a status signal.

presets.name: Glassmorphism (light)
presets.what: Milky translucent cards blurring pastel blue and pink colour blooms behind them, thin white edges, soft shadows.
presets.not: Not liquid glass: flat frosted panes with a white edge, no refraction, bending or specular rim.

presets.name: Fluent acrylic
presets.what: Grainy acrylic desktop windows over cool mint and lavender light, crisp rounded window chrome, soft layered depth like Windows 11.
use: developer tools with a gentle tone
presets.not: Not glassmorphism cards: the frost is noisy and matte like acrylic, and it lives in desktop windows with real chrome, not floating cards.

presets.name: Matte ceramic
presets.what: Bone and sage stoneware pills with a soft glazed highlight and short shadow, solid kiln-coloured icons, calm unfussy type.
presets.not: Not claymorphism: muted, earthy and heavy like fired stoneware, not candy-coloured and bouncy.

presets.name: Dreamy soft focus
presets.what: A hazy lilac-to-peach field with grain, a glowing pearl orb, a light italic serif and slow blurred dissolves, like a half-remembered morning.
presets.not: Not pastel minimal: the air is hazy, grainy and glowing, with a serif voice and blur transitions, not crisp and white.

presets.name: Organic biomorphic
presets.what: Soft sage and apricot pebble blobs drifting behind centred type, solid leaf-shaped icons, no straight edges anywhere.
presets.not: Not liquid chrome: the blobs are matte, muted and slow, like stones and leaves, not reflective fluids.

presets.name: Calm wellness
presets.what: A sage phone app with floating soft cards, faint breathing orbit rings, thin line icons and slow, weightless easing.
presets.not: Not pastel minimal: greener, quieter and built around a slow breath rhythm and app UI, not a single type moment.

presets.name: Vellum layers
presets.what: Translucent vellum sheets overlapping at slight angles over peach and blue shapes, fibre texture, tape tabs, gentle paper slides.
presets.not: Not layered cardstock: the sheets are see-through, so colours glow softly through them instead of stacking opaquely.

presets.name: Grainy pastel gradient
presets.what: Cards washed in a lavender-to-peach gradient over grainy colour blooms, soft glow, a wide rounded sans, colour doing the talking.
presets.not: Not glassmorphism: the cards are opaque gradient fills with grain, not see-through frosted panes.

presets.name: Calm biometric rings
presets.what: Soft sage progress rings and small readouts framed on a misty ground, rounded numerals, gentle sweeps like a sleep-tracker morning report.
presets.not: Not a sci-fi HUD: pale, rounded and slow, rings are progress not targeting, with no neon, glitch or scanlines.

presets.name: Cozy pastel terminal
presets.what: A rounded latte-toned terminal window with lavender and sage syntax colours, soft shadow, rounded mono type, typed line by line.
presets.not: Not a hacker terminal: light, pastel and rounded, with no green-on-black, scanlines or glitch.

presets.name: Soft flow diagram
presets.what: Rounded pastel nodes on a faint dot grid joined by soft dashed connectors, light shadows, duotone icons, gentle step-by-step pops.
presets.not: Not a blueprint or technical schematic: nodes are soft pastel lozenges with friendly type, not hairline technical drawing.

presets.name: Liquid glass
presets.what: Clear lens-like glass controls on a vivid coral-to-cobalt wallpaper, bright rim light and glow, surfaces that ripple and morph.
presets.not: Not flat glassmorphism: the glass bends and lenses what is behind it, glints at the edge and morphs between shapes.

presets.name: Nordic soft
presets.what: Flat fog-blue, oat and moss tiles in a calm grid, no shadows, thin line icons, a friendly sans, tidy slides.
presets.not: Not warm minimalism: cooler and flatter, a tidy grid of muted tiles and a sans voice rather than serif and terracotta.
